title: Transform adjoint normalization into native CPTP evolution plus a local potential
statement: For local GKLS D, A_D=D(I) and the GKLS map G_D with adjoint jumps and reversed Hamiltonian satisfy D_star(X)=G_D(X)+{A_D,X}/2. If support<=k and ||D||diamond<=1, ||A_D||infinity<=2^k and ||G_D||diamond<=4^k+2^k. Reversing the complete schedule turns mixed-input p(M)/t_M into Tr(Phi_star(rho_A)) from an explicit product state rho_A, with genuine CPTP evolution plus weak local Hermitian potential. The normalized tilted state is nonlinear; arbitrary product preparation survives as terminal2^n rho0.
